about: Tag-Team topics per level. mode relay = one team at the front, speakers take turns on one topic; mode debate = FOR team vs AGAINST team, speakers alternate. Times in seconds. M.2 and M.3 are the original sets; M.1 and the extra topics (to 50 per level) were written for Kru. Spin picks a random topic, no repeats until all are used.

M.1.title: Talk
M.1.label: Topic
topics: A perfect day at the beach
The best animal in the world
What I do at the weekend
If I had a pet dragon
What I want to be in the future
Things I love about my town
A day at the swimming pool
If I lived in the sea

intro.title: Tag-Team Talk
text: One team comes to the front.
Speakers take turns talking about one topic.

intro.title: Huddle first
text: Plan with your team for 30 seconds.
Who says what? Who starts? Who finishes?

intro.title: TAG!
text: At the chime, the next speaker continues.
Keep the same topic going!

intro.title: Challenge!
text: The audience can challenge for:
a 3-second silence, repeating an idea, off topic or Thai.

intro.title: Tag-Team Debate
text: Two teams at the front: FOR vs AGAINST.
Speakers take turns, starting with FOR.

intro.title: Huddle first
text: Plan your points for 1 minute 30.
Think: what will the other team say?

intro.title: Answer, then add
text: First answer the last point: "I disagree because…"
Then add a new point.

rows: I disagree because it helps us practise.

intro.title: Points
text: Challenge for silence, repeating, off topic or Thai.
The audience votes for the winning side.

before.name: Ask the audience
before.text: Ask the audience a question in your talk: +1.

secret.name: New word
secret.text: +1 for the best new word you used.

secret.name: Eye contact
secret.text: +1 if you looked at the audience.
